systems.name: Benter Model/Market Blend
systems.method: A fitted geometric blend combines the model's independent fundamental probability with the de-vigged public market, then looks for a positive probability overlay.
systems.adaptation: Uses the fields and chronological result history available in this project; it is not Bill Benter's proprietary Hong Kong model.
systems.status_note: Chronological fitting assigned zero extra weight to the independent fundamental probability; the market-only result creates no honest value bet.
